actionable_exact_outcome.definition: The named outcome occurred within 180 minutes of the model ETA
actionable_exact_outcome.denominator: Every scoreable bet; false alarms, wrong outcomes, and badly timed outcomes are misses

base_selection.base_pick_lift: Model capture rate divided by its scouted-region baseline
base_selection.capture: Selected base reached faction ownership by its scoring deadline
base_selection.exact_outcome: Observed outcome exactly matched the model's named outcome
base_selection.map_baseline: Share of all strategic bases at the round cutoff captured during the same bet window
base_selection.pipeline_lift: Model capture rate divided by the whole-map baseline
base_selection.scout_lift: Scouted-region baseline divided by the whole-map baseline
base_selection.scouted_baseline: Share of strategic bases in that model's six selected regions captured during the same bet window
base_selection.transition: Selected base had any physical ownership transition by its scoring deadline

Along the central spine, the rapid wave of transitions across the Linn of Mercy has slowed to six exchanges over the past six hours, yet fighting lingers near Fort Duncan and Lathair. To the east, Stlican Shelf has flared into prominence, logging two recent base captures around Thornhold alongside sharply accelerating casualty rates. Stonecradle and Lykos Isle absorbed several mid-day base shifts at The Heir's Knife and Astutia before tactical pacing eased. Meanwhile, attritional meat-grinders in Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse grind on unabated, with Dead Lands registering over five thousand casualties across the past two hours alone while Liberation Point and Abandoned Ward remain heavily contested. Endless Shore and Marban Hollow have consolidated without recent flips, while deep rear sectors across both northern and southern territories remain undisturbed.

history.headline: Violent Clashes Shatter Deadlock Across Linn Of Mercy And Central Fronts
history.war_summary: Breaking the territorial deadlock observed in yesterday's dispatch, combat across the central fronts has erupted into rapid operational movement, highlighted by sweeping base transitions in the Linn of Mercy. That sector has surged to become the focal point of active maneuvering, logging seventeen base exchanges over the past two hours as forces contest Fort Duncan, Lathair, Outwich Ranch, and surrounding redoubts. Meanwhile, raw attritional bloodletting has accelerated dramatically along the line: Dead Lands and the entrenched expanses of Weathered Expanse together registered over thirty thousand combined casualties in the latest two-hour reporting window, with bitter struggles persisting near Liberation Point and Sun's Hollow. To the east, Endless Shore and Marban Hollow maintain fierce turnover at Brackish Point and The Spitrocks, while coastal clashes continue to generate fresh friction across Farranac Coast, Stonecradle, and the Oarbreaker isles. Conversely, deep rear territories in the far north and southern interior remain entirely subdued behind the blazing frontline corridors.

history.headline: Base Shifts Stall Across Front As Weathered Expanse Slaughter Mounts
history.war_summary: Over the past three hours, direct base transitions have ground to a complete halt across the entire front, yet bloodletting has escalated sharply into pure attritional combat. Weathered Expanse has surged to become the war's deadliest sector, absorbing nearly two thousand combined casualties in the last two hours as enlistment rates accelerate dramatically. In Dead Lands, where intense base trading marked earlier dispatches, frontline movement has stalled following morning skirmishes near Sun's Hollow and Liberation Point, though heavy gunfire still claimed nearly two thousand lives in the latest reporting window. Marban Hollow emerged as a fresh contested zone during the morning hours, recording multiple base shifts around The Spitrocks and Checkpoint Bua before combat settled into an active stalemate. Attrition also remains elevated along the coastal and central corridors of Loch Mor, Farranac Coast, Endless Shore, and The Fingers, where casualty rates continue to climb despite unchanged territorial lines. Meanwhile, rear territories and consolidated zones like Drowned Vale remain thoroughly subdued.

history.headline: Dead Lands Battles Rage As Neighboring Fronts Settle Into Attrition
history.war_summary: Combat across the central front has narrowed over the past three hours, leaving the Dead Lands as the primary flashpoint for concrete territorial exchanges. Intense fighting around Liberation Point and Sun's Hollow produced three base transitions in the last two hours alone, driven by nearly two thousand combined casualties and a surging enlistment rate. By contrast, the recent flare-ups in Drowned Vale and Stema Landing have abruptly cooled, with base shifts halting entirely and Drowned Vale reporting a complete lull in casualties as Colonial forces secure the sector. Elsewhere, positional warfare without immediate base flips dominates the map. Fierce, accelerating casualty exchanges continue along the trenches of Weathered Expanse, where over nine hundred troops fell in two hours, alongside heavy skirmishing in Farranac Coast, Loch Mor, and Endless Shore. While frontline movement has temporarily frozen across these peripheral sectors, the steady buildup of reinforcements suggests severe pressure remains along the entire dividing line.

history.headline: Drowned Vale And Stema Landing Flare As Central Fronts Grind
history.war_summary: Drowned Vale and Stema Landing have surged into sudden violence over the past two hours, shifting the momentum away from Palantine Berm and Stlican Shelf, where base fighting has cooled to a halt. In Drowned Vale, seven fresh base transitions unfolded around Eastmarch and The Wash, accompanied by an accelerating influx of fresh troops. Stema Landing similarly registered five rapid base shifts, centered on contested works at The Wane. Meanwhile, Dead Lands continues its punishing grind as the war's bloodiest theater, recording over 3,300 combined casualties and two further base exchanges across the latest two-hour window. Further inland, casualty tolls are mounting sharply in Loch Mor and Weathered Expanse, with the latter absorbing over two thousand casualties in two hours despite frozen territory lines. Endless Shore and Farranac Coast remain locked in fierce attrition, while island fighting in The Fingers maintains an accelerating casualty pace following earlier captures around Tethys Base.

history.headline: Dead Lands And Coastal Sectors Erupt As Island Fronts Recede
history.war_summary: Fighting has flared sharply in Dead Lands and Palantine Berm over the past two hours, while earlier flurries in Tempest Island and Marban Hollow have largely subsided. Dead Lands has emerged as the most violent sector on the map, logging four base exchanges alongside more than four thousand combined casualties in the latest two-hour window, heavily contesting positions at Sun's Hollow and Liberation Point. Palantine Berm recorded four recent shifts of its own, driven by skirmishes around Leiri Hermanni and Vendett. Endless Shore remains locked in stubborn combat, adding three fresh base transitions to reach thirty-seven events on the day near Woodbind and Saltbrook Channel. Fresh tactical changes have also stirred Stlican Shelf around The South Wind and Thornhold, with coastal skirmishing registering in The Fingers and Stema Landing. Meanwhile, severe casualty tolls continue to mount across Weathered Expanse and Farranac Coast even as their fortified lines hold firm.

history.headline: Violent Frontline Shifts Sweep Coastal Islands and Central Midlands
history.war_summary: Combat across the midland and coastal sectors has intensified sharply over the past five hours, with violent base exchanges escalating in Tempest Island and Marban Hollow. Tempest Island witnessed eight strategic base changes in the latest two-hour window alone, contesting positions around The Gale and Reef, while Marban Hollow logged seven recent shifts around Maiden's Veil, Oster Wall, and The Spitrocks. Unrelenting friction persists in Endless Shore, which now records thirty-two base events over the day, centered on contested works at Woodbind, Wellchurch, and Saltbrook Channel. In the Drowned Vale, fighting remains brisk over The Wash and Eastmarch, tallying twenty total shifts. Concurrently, high-casualty engagements continue to test garrisons in Farranac Coast and Loch Mor, while heavy attrition in Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse mounts rapidly despite stabilizing perimeter lines. As enlistment surges cool relative to initial peak rates, both armies remain locked in stubborn contention across the primary operational corridors.

history.headline: Fierce Opening Clashes Erupt Across Central Fronts on Day Three
history.war_summary: War 140 enters its third day with sharp, escalating engagements across the central and coastal sectors. Heavy bloodletting defines the Dead Lands, Endless Shore, and Tempest Island, where combined casualties have already exceeded several thousands amidst fierce back-and-forth fighting. In Farranac Coast and the Drowned Vale, front lines remain exceptionally fluid, with each sector recording eleven base turnover events in the opening hours as key holdings such as Terra, Scythe, and Eastmarch are contested. Warden pushes have made measurable inroads in the Linn of Mercy and Fishermans Row, capturing multiple fortified positions, while Colonial assaults have made rapid headway through King's Cage and Clahstra. Across the theater, initial surge enlistments show signs of cooling as regional garrisons settle into organized combat. With 34 victory towns required to decide the war, neither side holds a decisive advantage as both armies maneuver along the contested midlands.

history.headline: Day 131
history.war_summary: On Day 131 of War 139, heavy frontline combat and frequent strategic base exchanges continue across several key sectors. The island and coastal theaters in Endless Shore, Oarbreaker, and Godcrofts exhibit the highest base turnover, recording numerous captures, neutralizations, and contested states over the past 2 to 6 hours around hotspots like Brackish Point, Grisly Refuge, and Argosa. On the mainland frontlines, Onyx, Clahstra, and Speaking Woods are absorbing massive casualty rates, with Onyx and Speaking Woods each sustaining over 3,000 casualties in the last two hours alone, while Clahstra has tilted to a 5-3 Warden advantage following continuous back-and-forth fighting around Transept and Bewailing Fort.

history.headline: Day 128
history.war_summary: On Day 128 of War 139, intense frontline pressure and heavy casualties continue across multiple contested sectors. Endless Shore and Oarbreaker remain the most volatile regions on the map, experiencing rapid base turnover, neutralizations, and contested states around key locations such as Brackish Point, Saltbrook Channel, Grisly Refuge, and Posterus. On the central and northern mainland fronts, Onyx, Callahans Passage, and Speaking Woods are sustaining massive casualty spikes—each seeing thousands of casualties over the past two hours with accelerating combat trends and recent base captures. Meanwhile, Clahstra remains evenly divided at 4-4 strategic base ownership following significant multi-base engagements across Transept and Bewailing Fort.

history.headline: Day 125
history.war_summary: On Day 125 of War 139, intense frontline combat is concentrated across key contested sectors with heavy attrition and rapid base turnover. Onyx is enduring an immense bloodbath with over 5,200 casualties in the last two hours and active contention over The Waif, while Callahans Passage and Speaking Woods show accelerating casualty rates and active territorial clashes. In the island and coastal sectors, Oarbreaker has erupted into a critical hotspot with nine base state changes in the past two hours around Grisly Refuge and Posterus. Clahstra continues to see relentless base flips and high casualties around Transept and Bewailing Fort, while Endless Shore maintains significant 24-hour turnover despite short-term casualty cooling.

history.headline: Day 122
history.war_summary: On Day 122 of War 139, intense frontline combat is concentrated across key contested sectors with high casualty rates and rapid strategic base turnover. Endless Shore and Clahstra continue as prime operational hotzones, sustaining massive attrition alongside frequent base captures and neutralizations, particularly around Transept and The Overland. Callahans Passage and Speaking Woods are actively contested with ongoing base exchanges and heavy casualties, while Mooring County exhibits a sharp resurgence in activity and base contests around Borderlane and Luch's Workshop. Additionally, Onyx is enduring an immense surge in casualties across its evenly split front.

history.headline: Day 119
history.war_summary: On Day 119 of War 139, high-tempo combat and frequent strategic base exchanges remain concentrated across volatile island fronts and contested central-eastern regions. Endless Shore continues as the primary operational hotspot with severe casualties and ongoing base flips, while Stema Landing, Godcrofts, and Onyx experience active contestation and recent ownership turnover. Meanwhile, Clahstra and Marban Hollow are sustaining massive, accelerating casualty rates across their contested frontlines, alongside substantial recent volatility in Oarbreaker.

history.headline: Day 116
history.war_summary: On Day 116 of War 139, heavy fighting and rapid base turnover remain concentrated across volatile island hexes and core contested frontlines. Endless Shore, Oarbreaker, and Godcrofts continue to experience relentless back-and-forth engagements with high event frequency. Simultaneously, active base captures and neutralizations are unfolding in Onyx and Stema Landing, while Clahstra sustains intense combat pressure and severe casualty exchanges.

history.headline: Day 113
history.war_summary: On Day 113 of War 139, intense frontline clashes and rapid base turnover persist across pivotal central and coastal battlegrounds. Endless Shore, Oarbreaker, and Godcrofts continue to experience relentless back-and-forth engagements and heavy base turnover. Meanwhile, massive casualty surges and fresh strategic pressure are escalating rapidly in Clahstra, Marban Hollow, and Speaking Woods, making these hexes the primary flashpoints for impending territory changes.

history.headline: Day 110
history.war_summary: On Day 110 of War 139, intense front-line combat and frequent base flips continue across key contested hexes and island sectors. Endless Shore remains an epicenter of heavy fighting and constant base turnover, mirrored by sustained naval and island contention in Godcrofts and Oarbreaker. On the mainland, massive casualty surges and recent base transitions dominate Marban Hollow, Olavis Wake, and Speaking Woods as both factions press contested border positions.

history.headline: Day 107
history.war_summary: On Day 107 of War 139, heavy combat is raging across both active island sectors and pivotal mainland frontlines. Island and coastal theaters remain highly volatile, with Oarbreaker and Godcrofts recording continuous base captures and neutralizations alongside intense clashes in Endless Shore. Concurrently, intense combat and accelerating casualty rates dominate key mainland transit corridors and contested borderlands, particularly across Olavis Wake, Marban Hollow, and Callahan's Passage.

history.headline: Day 104
history.war_summary: On Day 104 of War 139, intense combat is centered along both the central mainland fronts and active island/coastal theaters. Endless Shore and Godcrofts remain severe hotspots with ongoing base captures, neutralizations, and heavy casualty rates, while Stema Landing has experienced a recent flurry of base neutralizations and flips. Along the inland corridor, Callahan's Passage and Marban Hollow are witnessing massive casualty spikes exceeding thousands per hour as both factions contest key transit hubs and fortifications, complemented by persistent island engagements across Oarbreaker.

history.headline: Day 101
history.war_summary: On Day 101 of War 139, heavy combat and rapid base turnover are concentrated across coastal and central frontlines. Endless Shore and Oarbreaker remain the primary flashpoints with high casualty rates and continuous back-and-forth base captures, while Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf are experiencing active recent base contested status and flips. Simultaneously, massive casualty surges and accelerated enlistments in central mainland corridors such as Callahan's Passage, Marban Hollow, and Clahstra indicate large-scale offensives and fierce defensive stands along key strategic borders.

latest.headline: Coastal Outposts Contested as Fishermans Row and Farranac Flare
latest.war_summary: Fishermans Row has seen an immediate spike in combat over the past two hours, logging four rapid base exchanges across Fort Ember, Hangman's Court, and Arcadia. Farranac Coast maintains a blistering pace of fighting, clocking three additional base transitions around Scythe and Terra within the same window. Meanwhile, fighting on Tempest Island, Lykos Isle, and Godcrofts has begun to settle following heavy afternoon turnover, recording no further strategic changes in the last two hours. On the eastern front, Stlican Shelf registered fresh base contest around Fort Hoarfrost amid heavy casualty rates. Across the mainland interior, the bitter war of attrition grinds relentlessly onward: Dead Lands, Weathered Expanse, Marban Hollow, and King's Cage continue to absorb thousands of casualties every hour, yet defensive positions remain firmly locked with no strategic territorial shifts.

latest_all_time.headline: Coastal Outposts Contested as Fishermans Row and Farranac Flare
latest_all_time.war_summary: Fishermans Row has seen an immediate spike in combat over the past two hours, logging four rapid base exchanges across Fort Ember, Hangman's Court, and Arcadia. Farranac Coast maintains a blistering pace of fighting, clocking three additional base transitions around Scythe and Terra within the same window. history.headline: Fisherman's Row Rekindles While Farranac Coast Stays Hottest
history.war_summary: Farranac Coast holds its place as the liveliest sheet in the war, three base actions within the last two hours and twelve across the day, Scythe and Terra the most-worked grounds, the freshest entry in the field logged this evening. Fisherman's Row has rekindled since our last edition, four actions inside two hours about Fort Ember and Hangman's Court, its casualty returns climbing at an accelerating rate. Tempest Island, busiest in the previous dispatch, has fallen silent these two hours, though fifteen actions stand in its day's account; Lykos Isle likewise slackens to three in six, Fort Guile and The Squall still its most-contested works. Godcrofts keeps up a desultory exchange at Lipsia, and Stlican Shelf shows fresh movement at Fort Hoarfrost. The Dead Lands have filed no base movement since early afternoon, yet their ledger of some thirteen thousand Colonial and fifteen thousand Warden losses in a day remains second only to the Weathered Expanse, which stands silent in works but grimmest of all. This is the hundred-and-first day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Farranac Coast Erupts as Tempest Island Holds Busiest Hours
history.war_summary: The flare of the hour burns on Farranac Coast, four base actions inside two hours with Scythe the busiest works on that sheet, its losses now running past three thousand the hour between the armies. Tempest Island keeps pace close behind, thirteen actions across the day and the freshest report in the field, Blackwatch, the Isle of Psyche and Surge Gate all touched. Lykos Isle, hottest in our last dispatch, has slackened to a single action in two hours, though twenty-five stand across the day and Fort Guile and The Squall remain its most-worked grounds. Godcrofts has stirred anew around Lipsia, and Fishermen's Row stays busy at Arcadia and Peripti Landing. The Dead Lands have filed no base movement since early afternoon, yet their casualty ledger is the war's second grimmest; the Weathered Expanse, silent in works, tops it with more than thirty-three thousand losses in a day. This is the ninety-eighth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Lykos Isle Turns Hottest Front as Weathered Expanse Toll Mounts
history.war_summary: Three hours on, the map's din has moved. Lykos Isle is now the busiest sheet in the field, seven base actions inside the last two hours and twenty-two across the day, with Fort Guile and The Squall each touched eleven times; its split stands three Warden works to four Colonial. The Weathered Expanse keeps the grimmest ledger, hourly losses now past four thousand between the armies and still climbing, while the Dead Lands follow at nearly half that pace, The Salt March and Callahan's Boot the busiest works there, two more events logged inside the last two hours. Tempest Island stirred anew, four actions inside two hours, Blackwatch its busiest ground. Godcrofts, busiest in our last edition, has filed nothing since mid-morning, all nine works still Warden; Fishermen's Row likewise near seventeen hours silent. Marban Hollow, cooled in the previous report, has flared afresh, and Kings Cage with it. This is the ninety-fifth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Weathered Expanse Bleeds Steepest as Godcrofts Goes Wholly Warden
history.war_summary: The Weathered Expanse now heads the casualty ledger, its hourly losses climbing past thirteen hundred between the armies, the heaviest pace now showing on any front, while Marban Hollow, grimmest in our last edition, has markedly cooled. Base activity has shifted: The Fingers is the freshest sheet, three actions inside two hours at Headsman's Villa, in a region the Colonials hold seven-strong. Godcrofts, busiest over the day with seventeen events, now shows all nine works in Warden hands, Argosa and Lipsia again the hinges. Lykos Isle has tipped the other way, its Warden holdings reduced from four to three against four Colonial after trading at The Squall and Fort Guile. Tempest Island stirred at Blackwatch and Surge Gate mid-morning. The Deadlands and Farranac Coast have filed no base business since early morning, Fishermen's Row nearer fourteen hours silent, though over the full day the Deadlands' toll remains the war's largest. Stlican Shelf bleeds heavily on, eight Warden holdings to one Colonial. This is the ninety-second day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Marban Hollow's Toll Mounts as Lykos Isle Flares
history.war_summary: Since the last edition, Farranac Coast's flare has died, its last base action coming at half past five, and the Deadlands, so long the heaviest field, have filed nothing since four o'clock. Fishermen's Row, too, has stood silent near eleven hours. In their place Lykos Isle is the freshest sheet: two actions inside the past two hours, the latest within minutes of this writing, Fort Guile and The Squall the busiest posts, the island's seven works standing four Warden to three Colonial. Godcrofts keeps stirring, four events in six, Argosa and Lipsia again the centers of trade, seven Warden bases against one Colonial and one in no-man's-land. The grimmest ledger is Marban Hollow, where the casualty pace has climbed steeply in the past two hours — better than a thousand felled, Colonial losses more than doubled, some three hundred the hour on either side — though its eight bases still hold seven Colonial to one Warden. The Weathered Expanse bleeds at a like rate, steady rather than rising, while Stlican Shelf cools from its peak. This is the eighty-ninth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Farranac Coast Flares as Rival Fronts Fall Silent
history.war_summary: Tempest Island, last edition's lead, has gone still, Blackwatch quiet for nearly five hours, and Fishermen's Row, Godcrofts and Stema Landing's Wane have likewise fallen silent, their base events now six to eight hours old. Farranac Coast takes up the story: three events inside the past two hours, the last within the half-hour, with Mara and Scythe the busiest posts and two works taken by the Colonials among the day's six actions, the map now standing nine Colonial to two Warden. The Deadlands filed two events in the six-hour window but none since; The Salt March and Callahan's Boot again drew the heaviest trade, casualties still run above six hundred an hour a side, and the eleven works stand seven Colonial to four Warden. The Weathered Expanse runs a close second in the day's butcher's bill, its rate cooling. On Stlican Shelf, eight of nine works Warden-held, Warden losses have climbed past four hundred an hour. This is the eighty-sixth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Tempest Island Flares Anew as Stema Landing Goes Quiet
history.war_summary: Tempest Island leads this edition: Blackwatch, the isle's busiest post, saw action within the past two hours, the freshest event on any front, and the ledger now shows no work left in no-man's-land, the neutral ground returned to Colonial keeping. Stema Landing, our previous lead, has fallen silent, its last event more than three hours old, though The Wane logged six actions on the day and all nine works remain Colonial-held. Fishermen's Row still tops the day's ledger with twenty-three events, three inside six hours, its works standing eight Warden to one Colonial, Peripti Landing and Dankana Post drawing the busiest trade. Godcrofts counted nine actions over the day, Argosa the busiest, with all nine posts Warden-held. The Deadlands, eight hours without a base event, grind on regardless: casualties run near seven hundred an hour a side, The Salt March and Callahan's Boot the contested posts, eight of eleven works Colonial-held. Farranac Coast filed three actions at Mara, while Linn of Mercy and the Weathered Expanse stay quiet on bases though their casualty tallies remain steep. This is the eighty-third day of a war still awaiting its verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Stema Landing Wakes Anew as Deadlands Toll Mounts
history.war_summary: Stema Landing opens this dispatch: four base events in the past two hours, the newest logged some twenty minutes before filing, with The Wane the busiest post and all nine of its works still in Colonial hands. Fishermen's Row, our last edition's lead, remains the day's busiest ground, twenty-three events on the day's ledger and three more in the latest span; its nine works now stand eight Warden to one Colonial, a further turn from the seven-two split last reported, with Peripti Landing and Dankana Post again drawing the fire. Godcrofts has cooled to a single recent event, and its lone no-man's-land post has been restored, putting all nine works in Warden hands. The Deadlands have filed no base events for more than five hours, yet combined losses near four thousand in the past two hours and still climb; The Salt March and Callahan's Boot remain the contested posts, and eight of eleven works are Colonial-held. Tempest Island keeps one work in no-man's-land, while Linn of Mercy and Farranac Coast, quiet on bases, show steeply rising losses. The Weathered Expanse, likewise silent, counts better than fourteen thousand casualties a side over the day. This is the eightieth day of a war still awaiting its verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Fishermen's Row Rekindles as Godcrofts Front Falls Quiet
history.war_summary: Fishermen's Row, silent at our last edition, leads tonight's dispatch with five base events in the past two hours, the newest little more than half an hour before filing; Peripti Landing and Dankana Post bear the brunt, and its nine works now stand seven Warden to two Colonial, a marked swing from the five-and-four split last reported. The Deadlands returned to action some two hours before this edition, The Salt March and Callahan's Boot again the busiest posts, with eight of eleven works now Colonial-held. Godcrofts, the previous edition's lead, has cooled to a single event in the same span; eight works are Warden-held and one lies in no-man's-land. Farranac Coast has logged no fresh base events for better than three hours, yet its casualty pace still climbs. Linn of Mercy and Lykos Isle, both still divided, have filed no new base events for many hours, though Lykos casualties climb anew. Kings Cage and Marban Hollow, lately rising, now show cooling losses. The Weathered Expanse exacts the day's heaviest toll, more than fourteen thousand casualties on either side within twenty-four hours and still accelerating. This is the seventy-seventh day of the war; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is declared.

history.headline: Godcrofts Flares Anew as Fishermen's Row Falls Silent
history.war_summary: Since our last edition the map of activity has shifted. Godcrofts, which had been keeping still, now leads the dispatch: five base events in the past two hours, the latest shortly before our filing, centred on Argosa and Lipsia, and two of its works now lie demolished between the lines. Farranac Coast stirred within the past quarter-hour, fresh fighting recorded at Mara while its casualty pace climbs. Fishermen's Row, which roared through the day with twenty-five recorded events, has gone quiet; its newest entry is nearly three hours old and its nine works still divide five Warden to four Colonial. The Deadlands likewise rest since mid-afternoon, but not before the balance moved further to the Colonials, seven of eleven works now, with The Salt March the most contested post. Linn of Mercy and Lykos Isle, both still divided, have reported nothing since morning. Elsewhere the flags are unmoved though the toll mounts: Kings Cage and Marban Hollow show sharply rising hourly losses, and the Weathered Expanse passes thirty-two thousand casualties for the day without a change of colours. This is the seventy-fourth day of the war; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is declared.

history.headline: Fishermen's Row Erupts Anew as Deadlands Toll Mounts
history.war_summary: Since our last edition, Fishermen's Row has roared back to life after its brief lull: six base events in the past two hours, the latest at our filing, and its nine works narrowed to five Warden against four Colonial. The Deadlands logged no flips in the same span, its newest event a little over two hours old, yet the day's toll there passes 32,000 and its eleven works now read six Colonial to five Warden, the hourly pace easing from noon's fury. Kings Cage has seen no events since yesterday evening while its day's losses top 13,000, and the Weathered Expanse's exchange nears 34,000 without a change of flags. Fresh alarm comes from Clahstra, where casualties accelerate sharply though every work still flies Colonial colours. Lykos Isle has cooled, its last event four hours old with works split four Warden to three, while Linn of Mercy and Stlican Shelf both recorded captures within the day and remain divided. The remaining fronts stand quiet. This is the seventy-first day of the war; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is declared.

history.headline: Deadlands Fighting Quickens While Lykos Isle Flares Anew
history.war_summary: Since our last edition the weight of the fighting has shifted to the Deadlands, where three base events have fallen within the past two hours, the latest but an hour old; the day's toll of 14,008 Colonial and 18,740 Warden casualties now climbs at the war's steepest Warden rate, with its eleven works standing seven Colonial to four. Fishermen's Row, busiest at our previous filing, has gone silent these three hours, yet its casualty rate still accelerates and its nine works remain seven Warden to two Colonial. Lykos Isle emerges as a fresh flashpoint, two events inside two hours, the latest under one, its seven works split four Warden to three Colonial. The Weathered Expanse retains the heaviest day's exchange at some 35,000 casualties, Colonial fire accelerating while Warden rates waver from hour to hour. Kings Cage has logged no base events since yesterday evening, though its day's losses pass twelve thousand and Warden losses rise sharply. Linn Mercy's fifteen events all lie nine hours back and its front cools. Elsewhere the lines hold quiet: sixty-eight days of war, thirty-four victory towns the prize, and no victor declared.

history.headline: Fishermen's Row Changes Hands as Deadlands Fighting Renews
history.war_summary: The chief change since our last edition comes at Fishermen's Row, where the day's tally of base events has climbed from twenty-one to twenty-eight, seven falling within the past two hours and the latest logged at this edition's filing; its nine works now stand seven Warden to two Colonial, reversed from five Colonial to four Warden, with Dankana Post the busiest ground. The Deadlands, silent at our prior report, record two fresh base events, the latest near two hours old, their eleven works standing seven Colonial to four Warden. The Weathered Expanse now bears the war's heaviest day's exchange, some thirty-five thousand casualties in twenty-four hours, the latest hour cooling even as the two-hour rate climbs anew. Kings Cage has seen no base events since yesterday evening, yet its day's losses pass eleven thousand. Linn Mercy's fifteen base events all fall outside the past six hours, though its casualty rates remain heavy. Farranac Coast shows fresh acceleration without a change of flags. Sixty-five days in, no victor is declared and thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Fishermen's Row Flares Anew as Kings Cage Toll Mounts
history.war_summary: The chief change since our last edition comes at Fishermen's Row, silent at the prior filing, where two base events fall within the past two hours, the latest but half an hour before this edition, and twenty-one mark the day, with losses on both sides accelerating sharply; its nine works stand five Colonial to four Warden. Kings Cage, quiet in base affairs since yesterday evening, shows the sharpest fresh climb in casualties, some forty-two hundred colonial and sixty-four hundred warden across the day and swelling hourly, its eight works seven Colonial to one Warden. The Deadlands remain the costliest field, their losses still rising in the latest hour, though no fresh base events are recorded since our last report; eight works stand Colonial to three Warden. Linn Mercy keeps up its heavy exchange without new base events, while the Weathered Expanse's great torrent of casualties at last cools, and Lykos Isle, Stlican Shelf, Loch Mor and Clahstra subside from their peaks. Palantine Berm, absent from our last report, shows a small fresh flare, nearly all of its day's losses falling within six hours. Sixty-two days in, no victor is declared and thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Quiet Linn Mercy Erupts Anew as Deadlands Battle Rages On
history.war_summary: The chief change since our last edition comes from Linn Mercy, listed quiet at the prior filing, where four base events inside two hours and casualty rates leaping from near nothing to roughly a hundred an hour a side mark a sudden flare; its eleven works stand nine Warden to two Colonial. The Deadlands remain the busiest field: two more base events in the past two hours, the latest a quarter-hour before this edition, nine in the day, and losses accelerating anew in the latest hour, with eight works Colonial to three Warden. Lykos Isle, freshest at last report, has gone still these two hours, its tally five Warden to two Colonial, and Fishermen's Row keeps its after-flurry silence. The Weathered Expanse continues its enormous hemorrhage, near twenty-four thousand colonial and twenty-three thousand warden casualties in a day and swelling again in the latest hour, though its nine works all remain in Warden keeping. Stlican Shelf, Loch Mor and Clahstra cool from their peaks, and Endless Shore is nearly still. Fifty-nine days in, no victor is declared and thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Fishermen's Row Falls Silent as Lykos Isle Flares
history.war_summary: With this edition the front that led our last report has hushed: Fishermen's Row, which counted eight base events in two hours at evening filing, records none in the hours since, though its ledger stands six works Colonial to three Warden and its casualty columns cool steadily from heavy heights. Lykos Isle now claims the freshest action, new events logged as late as half past ten, its works split four Warden to three Colonial and its losses accelerating in the latest hour. The Deadlands renewed base movement in the evening, seven works flying Colonial colors against four Warden, with tolls easing from their enormous peaks; Stlican Shelf's climbing rates, noted at last filing, now cool. Loch Mor and Clahstra register sharply rising casualty figures without recorded base events, and the Weathered Expanse continues its immense hemorrhage, near three thousand in two hours, all nine of its works still in Warden keeping. Kings Cage, Linn Mercy, Endless Shore, Stonecradle and Tempest Island remain quiet. Fifty-six days in, no victor is declared and thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Fishermen's Row Flares Anew as Deadlands and Stlican Shelf Bleed
history.war_summary: Since our last edition the exchange has swung back to Fishermen's Row: eight base events in two hours, the latest logged at the moment this dispatch was filed, and the ledger now reads six works Colonial to three Warden, a marked turn from the balance reported at midafternoon. The Deadlands and Stlican Shelf poured out enormous two-hour tolls, near eight thousand and better than three thousand respectively, with both rates still climbing; yet the Deadlands have seen no base movement since midmorning. The Weathered Expanse bleeds nearly as heavily without a single base event on its books. Kings Cage, which led our previous report, has cooled in the latest hour and its base action paused in late afternoon; Linn Mercy, after thirty-two events in the day, now shows all eleven of its works in Warden hands while its wounded columns mount. Lykos Isle has flared anew, with fresh events logged as this edition closed. Endless Shore, Stonecradle and Tempest Island, busy in earlier bulletins, have gone quiet.

history.headline: Kings Cage Erupts as Fishermen's Row and Stlican Shelf Trade Blows
history.war_summary: The storm has shifted. Kings Cage, little noted in our last edition, now pours out the war's fiercest new toll — better than three thousand casualties in the past two hours, the rate still climbing, with the day's seven base events all logged at Den of Knaves, the latest shortly before this edition went to press. Fishermen's Row keeps its grip on the exchange ledger: seven more base events inside two hours, Dankana Post the busiest of all, and the Colonials now hold three of nine works to the Wardens' six. Stlican Shelf bleeds at an accelerating pace, its latest base movement recorded at filing time, while Tempest Island saw fresh fighting at Isle of Psyche in the same hour. Linn Mercy, which led our last edition with twenty-nine base events, has slowed to a trickle, ten of its eleven works now Warden-held. The Deadlands remain the bloodiest field, some thirty-four thousand lost there in a day, though the two-hour pace has eased and no base event has been recorded since midmorning. Endless Shore has gone quiet since morning and Stonecradle's late flare has cooled, but the Weathered Expanse, untouched on the base ledger, still feeds the casualty columns.

history.headline: Fighting Rekindles at Fishermen's Row as Base Exchanges Mount
history.war_summary: Another edition goes to press with no decision rendered, and the fighting has found fresh addresses. Fishermen's Row, little noted in our last report, now draws the eye: four exchanges in the past two hours and fifteen within the day, the last logged as this dispatch is filed, leaving the Wardens six works, the Colonials two, and one post demolished between the lines. Linn Mercy outdid even that count with twenty-nine changes, nine of its eleven posts now Warden-held, while Endless Shore counted twenty-one, Brackish Point alone trading thirteen times, though its ledger still reads wholly Colonial. The Deadlands remain split six to five, their combined twenty-four-hour toll near thirty-three thousand and still climbing; the Weathered Expanse, though no post changed hands on record there, feeds the same grim arithmetic. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle logged sharp exchanges as well, the latter now cooling, and Oarbreaker and Marban Hollow remain divided ground. Elsewhere, from Acrithia to the Umbral Wildwood, settled provinces record only light losses, yet fresh names swell every enlistment roll without pause.

history.headline: Forts Trade Hands by the Hour Along Contested Middle Belt
history.war_summary: With no decision yet rendered on the thirty-seventh day of the war, the map stands divided between settled districts and a burning central belt. Most provinces rest firmly under one banner, but the Deadlands remain split six bases to five, while neighboring Linn Mercy flashed through twenty-three ownership changes in a single day, its posts passing back and forth almost by the hour. Endless Shore counted sixteen similar convulsions, with Brackish Point the busiest crossing, and Farranac Coast, Marban Hollow, and Oarbreaker — where one work now lies in ruin — each logged fighting inside the last two hours. In the Fishermen's Row and Godcrofts sectors the Wardens hold near-complete ground, though Colonial flags were raised over individual points within the day. The casualty ledger is heaviest in the Deadlands, where the combined toll since the war began approaches fifty thousand. Fresh names appeared on every regional roll through the day, an unbroken tide of enlistment amid the churn.

latest.headline: Fisherman's Row Rekindles While Farranac Coast Stays Hottest
latest.war_summary: Farranac Coast holds its place as the liveliest sheet in the war, three base actions within the last two hours and twelve across the day, Scythe and Terra the most-worked grounds, the freshest entry in the field logged this evening. Fisherman's Row has rekindled since our last edition, four actions inside two hours about Fort Ember and Hangman's Court, its casualty returns climbing at an accelerating rate. Tempest Island, busiest in the previous dispatch, has fallen silent these two hours, though fifteen actions stand in its day's account; Lykos Isle likewise slackens to three in six, Fort Guile and The Squall still its most-contested works. Godcrofts keeps up a desultory exchange at Lipsia, and Stlican Shelf shows fresh movement at Fort Hoarfrost. The Dead Lands have filed no base movement since early afternoon, yet their ledger of some thirteen thousand Colonial and fifteen thousand Warden losses in a day remains second only to the Weathered Expanse, which stands silent in works but grimmest of all. This is the hundred-and-first day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Dead Lands Bleed On as Fresh Fronts Flare Across the Map
history.war_summary: The twentieth day of the war shows no slackening at the front. In the Dead Lands the ledger has climbed to eleven thousand eight hundred sixty-nine Colonial and thirteen thousand five hundred ninety-eight Warden names since our last edition, with base activity logged as recently as mid-morning; seventeen events stand recorded across the day, chiefly at Liberation Point and Sun's Hollow, and the strongpoint count there holds at seven Wardens against four Colonials. Marban Hollow is the freshest field of action, its last entry filed only hours ago amid a five-to-three Colonial edge and a casualty toll climbing fast on both sides. Weathered Expanse reports enormous losses — seven thousand seven hundred forty-nine against seven thousand five hundred seven — with rates accelerating sharply, though not a single base movement appears in its record. Callahan's Passage likewise burns hot, warden losses outpacing colonial ones as enlistments surge. Endless Shore, yesterday's busiest field with forty-two events around Woodbind and Saltbrook Channel, has gone quiet since the small hours; Drowned Vale and Farranac Coast have also stilled. Rear provinces from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors, and thirty-four victory towns remain required before any victor may be declared.

history.headline: Dead Lands Toll Mounts as Seventeenth Day Grinds On
history.war_summary: The ledger of the Dead Lands grows heavier by the hour. Since our last edition the region's dead have risen to ten thousand five hundred Colonial and eleven thousand eight hundred Warden names, with fresh base activity logged as recently as this morning; seventeen events stand recorded across the day at Liberation Point and Sun's Hollow above all, and the balance of strongpoints there has shifted to seven Wardens against four Colonials. Endless Shore remains the day's busiest field with forty-two recorded events around Woodbind, Saltbrook Channel and Wellchurch, though its last entry came hours ago and the front has since gone quiet on current readings. Drowned Vale, which roared overnight at Eastmarch and The Wash, has likewise fallen silent in recent hours. Farranac Coast shows nine bases Colonial to two Warden with warden losses accelerating sharply, while Loch Mor bleeds heavily at Westmarch and Market Road and Marban Hollow's toll is climbing fast despite a thin six-to-two Colonial edge. Weathered Expanse counts enormous casualties without a single recorded base movement. Elsewhere the map holds firm: rear provinces from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors, and thirty-four victory towns are required before any victor may be declared.

history.headline: Eighth Day Finds Central Fronts Ablaze, Casualties Soar
history.war_summary: Since our last edition the war has entered its bloodiest stretch yet. The central corridor burns without pause: the Dead Lands alone have counted over five thousand casualties a side, while Drowned Vale, Endless Shore, Farranac Coast, and Weathered Expanse each report totals running into the thousands, with fresh losses still arriving at hundreds per hour despite a brief cooling in the latest readings. Ownership continues to seesaw. Drowned Vale logged twenty base events in a day, its Wash and Eastmarch posts changing hands repeatedly, and Endless Shore matched that fury with thirty-two events around Woodbind and Wellchurch. Farranac Coast leans Colonial at ten bases to one, yet Warden columns struck back through Palantine Berm and Linn of Mercy, where nine captures were recorded. Fisherman's Row went heavily to the Wardens, while Clahstra and Kings Cage swung Colonial. Tempest Island and Marban Hollow remain open sores, trading posts through the night. Quiet reigns elsewhere — Godcrofts, Mooring County, and their neighbors sit undisturbed behind undisputed flags. Thirty-four victory towns are required for victory; none has fallen.

history.headline: Casualties Mount as Third Day of War Brings Fierce Fighting

The heaviest fighting rages across the central corridor: the Dead Lands, Endless Shore, Farranac Coast, and Tempest Island all report casualties accelerating sharply hour over hour, with totals already past fifteen hundred per side in several sectors. Base activity is concentrated there too — Farranac Coast logged eleven capture events in two hours, Endless Shore ten, and the Dead Lands five, with ownership trading hands in both directions. The Colonials pressed gains in Kings Cage and Clahstra, while Warden counterattacks swept through Linn of Mercy, Marban Hollow, and Fisherman's Row, where five straight captures were recorded. Drowned Vale remains the busiest single front, eleven events in two hours leaving one strategic base in no-man's-land. By contrast, wide stretches of the map — Godcrofts, Mooring County, Stema Landing, and their like — sit quiet under undisputed flags, their enlistment flows cooling after an early surge. With thirty-four victory towns required and none yet decided, correspondents watch the contested middle for the first true break.

rounds.war_summary: Another edition goes to press with no decision rendered, and the fighting has found fresh addresses. Fishermen's Row, little noted in our last report, now draws the eye: four exchanges in the past two hours and fifteen within the day, the last logged as this dispatch is filed, leaving the Wardens six works, the Colonials two, and one post demolished between the lines. The Deadlands remain split six to five, their combined twenty-four-hour toll near thirty-three thousand and still climbing; the Weathered Expanse, though no post changed hands on record there, feeds the same grim arithmetic. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle logged sharp exchanges as well, the latter now cooling, and Oarbreaker and Marban Hollow remain divided ground. Elsewhere, from Acrithia to the Umbral Wildwood, settled provinces record only light losses, yet fresh names swell every enlistment roll without pause.

Weathered Expanse counts enormous casualties though no base events, suggesting pressure without movement. Rear regions from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors. Thirty-four victory towns are required; none has yet fallen.

rounds.war_summary: The war is in its late stage (day 84) with no winner yet. The Colonials hold a significant majority of strategic bases, controlling most of the map, while the Wardens maintain a strong presence in a few key regions. Recent activity is concentrated in a central band of regions, with intense back-and-forth fighting in Clahstra, Stlican Shelf, Mooring County, Oarbreaker, Onyx, and others. The Colonials appear to be pushing on multiple fronts, but the Wardens are contesting fiercely, leading to frequent base ownership changes. The overall strategic picture is fluid, with the Colonials holding a numerical advantage but the Wardens showing resilience in contested areas.

data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.
